verdict.rationale: Notion is a SaaS workspace with built-in AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers whether customer data is used for model training, or any setting to opt out. Connection and MCP access controls govern which tools can reach the workspace, not training use, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
